resources.string: Fill forms by voice: say "fill this form".

When you say "fill this form", ROOSTER fills the empty fields it recognises (name, phone, email, address, city, state, PIN code, date of birth) with the details you saved in ROOSTER. It reads the screen only when you ask, never stores or uploads what is on screen, never presses submit, and never fills passwords, OTPs, PINs, card or bank details.
